run_token.origin: fresh random nonce plus immutable workflow/run attempt identity; collision refuses before mutation

selection.origin: existing harness parser; no shell splitting

instance.conf.utf8:
[Unit]
OnSuccess=
OnFailure=
[Service]
Slice=tc-ra-{run_token}.slice
Restart=no
RestartForceExitStatus=
TimeoutStopSec=240s

guest-setup.service.utf8:
[Unit]
Description=Acceptance guest OS setup
After=local-fs.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/srv/teleclaude-candidate
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3.12 -P /srv/teleclaude-candidate/tools/ci/runtime_acceptance.py --enclosure-role guest-setup --enclosure-manifest /var/lib/teleclaude-runtime-acceptance/manifest.json
TimeoutStartSec=300s
Restart=no
RestartForceExitStatus=

payload.service.utf8:
[Unit]
Description=Acceptance payload
OnSuccess=tc-ra-poweroff.service
OnFailure=tc-ra-poweroff.service
[Service]
Type=exec
User=runner
Group=runner
WorkingDirectory=/srv/teleclaude-candidate
SetLoginEnvironment=yes
Environment=HOME=/home/runner USER=runner LOGNAME=runner SHELL=/bin/bash LANG=C.UTF-8 CI=true
Environment=PATH=/home/runner/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus
Environment=COREPACK_HOME=/opt/telec-ra/corepack COREPACK_DEFAULT_TO_LATEST=0 COREPACK_ENABLE_NETWORK=0
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/uv run --offline --no-project --python /usr/bin/python3.12 python -P /srv/teleclaude-candidate/tools/ci/runtime_acceptance.py --enclosure-role payload --enclosure-manifest /var/lib/teleclaude-runtime-acceptance/manifest.json --profile full --root /srv/teleclaude-candidate --source-revision {candidate_sha} --source-tree {candidate_tree} --select {selection} --report /var/lib/teleclaude-runtime-acceptance/report.json
Restart=no
RestartForceExitStatus=
KillMode=process

poweroff.service.utf8:
[Unit]
Description=Acceptance guest poweroff
DefaultDependencies=no
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/srv/teleclaude-candidate
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3.12 -P /srv/teleclaude-candidate/tools/ci/runtime_acceptance.py --enclosure-role guest-poweroff --enclosure-manifest /var/lib/teleclaude-runtime-acceptance/manifest.json
TimeoutStartSec=30s
Restart=no
RestartForceExitStatus=

diagnostic@.service.utf8:
[Unit]
Description=Inert qualification service %i
[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStart=/usr/bin/sleep infinity
Restart=no
RestartForceExitStatus=
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=10s

rendering.escaping: systemd syntax escaping, including percent specifiers; each argv field remains one argument; no shell expansion or free-form appended options
rendering.source_realization: reviewed implementation demonstrates emitted unit/config bytes equal the static template after only declared substitutions

host.host_changes: Only install absent exact-locked systemd-container when every other dependency already satisfies the reviewed host lock and no removal/upgrade is proposed. Never replace/restart PID1 or alter unrelated units.
host.vendor_exec: unchanged installed vendor template invocation, including --keep-unit --boot --network-veth -U --settings=override
host.runtime_mask: exact active instance, without --now; retain through job end
preconditions: existing host systemd-networkd active with the locked container-veth network configuration
no non-package or unknown drop-in, alias, transient job or activation source targeting this instance, parent or rootfs
all existing host package/interpreter/template digests match the static host lock; mismatch stops before privileged changes

Before an absent-container package install, no foreign enabled/transient machine instance or pending machines.target activation may exist; its locked postinst may enable/start machines.target and reload manager definitions. Observe the actual effects before parent binding, without changing PID1 generation.

guest.package_materialization: extract authenticated package data files only while offline; execute no package control script outside the guest. Stage all exact archives. After boot, verified namespace and host seal, guest-setup unpacks/configures only these archives inside the boundary. No apt floating resolution or host bus bind.

account.name: runner
account.created_by: guest-setup through guest OS account tools after namespace verification
account.bus: supported guest logind/linger; actual owner and system/user bus positively verified

guest.tools: verified Node/uv/corepack/prettier/pnpm artifacts from static lock; root-owned guest tool prefix and precreated supported corepack shims/cache, no application home/config/auth seed
guest.source: clean candidate copy matching realization commit/tree and unchanged dependency basis digests

package_service_policy.interface: policy-rc.d service action; every attempted package service action returns exit101 and starts nothing
package_service_policy.implementation_bytes: belong to the postimplementation source-realization record
package_service_policy.lifetime: installed before guest package unpack/configure; removed before supported product installer; guest script only, never executed on host

helper_protocol.admission: Verify source/interpreter/lock/recipe/run/path/action before every mutation; fsync protected intent before call and actual result after. Unknown acknowledgment permits only bounded closure/read/export, never retry or replacement.
helper_protocol.terminal_admission: After mask-guest no second host guest start; after start-payload no second payload start; after shutdown no start action. Sealing is monotonic and not reopened by process restart.
helper_protocol.outside_execution: Only named source-reviewed provision/query/export actions, no TeleClaude application/native work or arbitrary shell text.

observer.continuous_binding: one non-reconnecting system-bus connection subscribed before parent binding; bind bus ID, systemd owner, host boot, parent object path, service invocation and guest generation. Disconnect, owner change, malformed/partial stream or missing subscription is unproven.
observer.cgroup_api: ControlGroup from same manager; read-only original O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY|O_CLOEXEC directory fd and original openat cgroup.events O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC fd; no reopen-by-name
observer.notifications: Linux inotify via native libc, watch anchored original parent and cgroup.events; IN_DELETE_SELF, IN_MOVE_SELF, IN_UNMOUNT, IN_IGNORED and IN_Q_OVERFLOW invalidate. Kernel cgroup.events IN_MODIFY supplies population changes, never replaces raw final read. Any unsupported watch or monitoring gap is unproven.
observer.termination: positive same-invocation guest poweroff, service inactive, no forced kill/reboot/unknown jobs, active original parent and sealed mask; then raw recursive populated 0 through original descriptor

immutable_inputs: effect ledger and all independent retention keys
public P1/P2 facts and same-generation P3 outcome
reports.upload_claim: Final local report records export readiness, never the success of its own later upload. Remote upload eligibility/result is separately observed workflow evidence; missing or failed mandatory export prevents the overall acceptance/delivery claim.
conditional_only: separately approved B14 sidecar; no B14 matrix authority
no snapshot acquisition/schema/carrier/export additions from withdrawn optional dad7 route

realization_contract.created_after: implementation at exact candidate commit/tree, before source review and qualification
fields: controller/helper source path and byte digest
outside and guest interpreter/library byte digests
realized templates and normalized declared-parameter rendering digests
realization_contract.static_stage_contains: vendor byte locks and exact declarative recipes, not future implementation code bytes
realization_contract.runtime_stage_adds: observed namespace/manager/boot/invocation/object identities and effective property readbacks; these are not claimed by static review
